questions.prompt: Which image and patch sizes make the old reconstruct_from_patches_2d wrong?

points.text: A patch dimension equals the image dimension.

evidence.quote:
when a patch dimension equals the corresponding image
  dimension.

questions.prompt: Why does adding n_h and n_w to the divisor fix it?

points.text: Each pixel is divided by how many patches overlap it.

evidence.quote: # divide by the amount of overlap

points.text: n_h is the number of patch positions along the height (i_h - p_h + 1); a pixel can't be covered by more patches than that.
The new divisor takes the minimum with n_h and n_w too.

evidence.quote: min(i + 1, p_h, n_h, i_h - i) * min(j + 1, p_w, n_w, i_w - j)

questions.prompt: What does the new test do, and what must be true at the end?

points.text: It cuts a random image into patches and rebuilds it.
The rebuilt image must equal the original.
